findings: Mount tightening verified: dispatch wrapper raises on os.path.ismount('/content/drive') failure before capture_cell's mkdir can create any log/output directory; launcher re-checks mount+MyDrive before job.mkdir; FIND_CELL walks Drive only when mounted and reports drive_mounted; poll_cell returns NOT_VISIBLE when unmounted; regression test test_unmounted_drive_refuses_before_any_output_directory proves refusal with Path.mkdir never called.

Review gate sound: require_patient_review binds p001-dispatch-r2 execution/response (APPROVE, scope p001-patient-dispatch, matching reviewed_commit, claude-fable-5 in modelUsage, response SHA-256) and re-hashes all nine REVIEW_FILES against input_file_sha256; enforced at both packet build and worker dispatch; original scientific verify_receipt checked first; p001-dispatch-approved evidence untouched.

Scientific pins and cells unchanged: NOTEBOOK_PIN 1a81c037/SOURCE_PIN d6a1184b intact; child executes exact pinned cells 3/4/5 as literals with DATA_ROOT=None; acquisition cell 1 byte-exact inside private capture wrapper; run.py archive MD5/size, 198-member, 99-case, checkpoint and 60-minute-cap invariants unmodified.

Dispatch mechanics safe: archive_path rejects non-/content roots, traversal, control chars, 047 staging root; pre-existing worker dir causes nondestructive refusal (raced mkdir fails closed); detached child via start_new_session with private console; launcher-owned failures write FAILED; MCP-visible stream is only the fixed {transport_status, source_sha256} dict validated against sha256(launch_source).

Validation-before-success and packaging correct: VALIDATED written only after original validate_return.verify reproduces aggregates from private checkpoints; zip re-verifies aggregate hashes, refuses symlinks in recursed folders, includes console/binding/index/predictions/checkpoints/failed_attempts, excludes staged/ (tested).

Source readback binding enforced: verify_cell_sources requires both inserted code and post-insertion readback to equal packet sources per execution index, pops readback on update_cell, rejects delete/move and extra runs, and requires includeOutputs=false on get_cells; COMPLETE additionally requires exact CPU/Colab check output.

Non-blocking: verify_discovery accepts COMPLETE locate results with drive_mounted:false (empty candidates) — flag is surfaced and documented but callers must heed it; zip symlink check does not individually cover binding.json/checkpoint_index.json (folder trees are checked). Neither blocks the dispatch scope.
No tests were executed and no tools were run; this is a static review of the supplied sources only.
